name: Dismantlable Ample Peripheral-Expansion Theorem
statement: For an isometric site $S\subseteq B$, the specified peripheral expansion $P=(B\times\{0\})\cup(S\times\{1\})$ is dismantlable ample if and only if both $B$ and $S$ are dismantlable ample.
proof: Concatenate a prefix-isometric order of the lower copy of $B$ with one of the upper copy of $S$; lower, upper, and cross-layer pairs all have shortest paths inside every prefix. Conversely, $B$ is a contraction and $S$ a semicube restriction of $P$.
